# Data-quality notes (generated by scripts/01_eda.py)

* Partitions explored: train (80 trips), student_test (10 trips). Evaluator partition not explored.
* All four files present for every trip: True.
* GPS rows with NaN: 0; non-increasing timestamps: 0.
* Sampling: median 1 s; share of exact 1 s steps 94.3% (mean over trips); max gap 153064 s; trips with a gap > 30 s: 30.
* Trips span 25 UTM zones on several continents, so each trip is projected to its own UTM zone.
* Road networks: 649–307392 arcs; duplicate arcs in 60 trips (mapped to a canonical arc); self-loops in 9 trips; isolated nodes in 0 trips.
* Two-way roads are stored as two opposite arcs (mean 92% of arcs have a reverse twin), so direction of travel matters: heading features are required.
* Reference routes: ids valid in all trips = True; consecutive arcs connected 99.94% on average; trips with repeated arcs (loops / out-and-back): 10.
* The .route file is one arc sequence per trip, not one label per GPS row. Per-observation labels are obtained with a monotone alignment (pathsnap/labels.py).
* Median GPS-to-reference distance 4.7 m; but some trips contain GPS sections far from the reference route (reference may not cover the full track, or GPS drift):
  * train/00000054: 88.3% of points > 60 m from route, max 241 m
  * train/00000033: 52.4% of points > 60 m from route, max 160 m
  * train/00000002: 11.7% of points > 60 m from route, max 570 m
  * train/00000043: 6.3% of points > 60 m from route, max 194 m
  * train/00000066: 6.2% of points > 60 m from route, max 647 m
* Candidate generation (radius 60 m, max 12 arcs): mean miss rate 2.02% (train 2.25%), 8.7 candidates per point on average.
* Decisions: invalid/duplicate-time rows removed; points whose reference arc is outside the candidate set are kept and always count as errors in Top-1 accuracy (no optimistic filtering).
